標題： 原訂校務行政系統主機更新與維護行程取消 (Cancellation of Scheduled School Administrative-affair System Upgrade and Maintenance)
日期： Mon, 28 Apr 2025 08:49:50 +0800

各位師長、同仁、同學們好：

原訂於114年4月29日（星期二）中午12:10至13:00進行之校務行政資訊系統主機更新與維護作業，因故取消，並延期至5月進行。
在原訂時間內，校務行政資訊系統將維持正常運作，不影響各項使用。

造成不便，敬請見諒，感謝您的理解與支持！

圖書資訊處 校務系統組 敬上
分機 6752

Dear faculty, staff, and students,

The scheduled upgrade and maintenance for the School Administrative-affair System, originally planned from 12:10 PM to 1:00 PM on April 29, 2025 (Tuesday), has been cancelled and postponed to May.
During the originally scheduled time, the system will remain available for normal use.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause, and thank you for your understanding and support.

Extension 6752
System Development Division
Office of Library and Information Services
